title: Truchas phase change
description: A temperature-dependent transformation between two consecutive material phases.

smooth-phase-change.title: Smooth phase change
smooth-phase-change.description: A smooth phase change defined by its solidus and liquidus temperatures.

solidus-temp.description: Temperature at or below which the lower-temperature phase has fraction one.

liquidus-temp.description: Temperature at or above which the lower-temperature phase has fraction zero.

latent-heat.description: Optional latent heat assigned to the transformation. It is needed when the high-temperature phase enthalpy is inferred from its specific heat.

tabular-phase-change.title: Tabular phase change
tabular-phase-change.description: A phase change defined by temperature and lower-temperature-phase fraction pairs.

solid-frac-table.description: Two or more [temperature, fraction] pairs. Temperatures must be strictly monotone, and the endpoint fractions must be 0 and 1 in either order.

latent-heat.description: Optional latent heat assigned to the transformation. It is needed when the high-temperature phase enthalpy is inferred from its specific heat.
